items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: And we was kidding around or something and Chubby says, “Ahh shut up, I’ll give it to ya.” So I don’t know, Sonny says, “Yeah whadda ya mean?”

ctx.x: Well he was, see? And we was kidding around or something and Chubby says, “Ahh shut up, I’ll give it to ya.” So I don’t know, Sonny says, “Yeah whadda ya mean?” And boom, he knocked him down. He didn’t hit him, but he knocked him down and he pinned him down. And then he grabbed me—
He put you down too, huh? He is a spark plug, I’ll give him that.
